registration.title: Registration
registration.description: Controls whether new users can register. When disabled, the register page shows a "Registration closed" notice; existing users can still log in.
registration.reasonLabel: Reason for the change (optional, for audit)
registration.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Closing sign-ups before the official launch / temporarily closed during maintenance

languages.title: System language defaults
languages.description: These values apply when a user follows the system default or has not chosen a preference. Personal settings take priority, and existing stories and articles are not changed retroactively.
languages.displayHint: The default CMS language for accounts without a personal interface preference.
languages.contentHint: The default content language for new stories, articles, and AI writing.

features.warning: When a feature is disabled, its top-level entry is hidden from the sidebar and direct API calls are blocked. Auto-publish background jobs and payment callbacks are not affected.
features.enableDescription: Once enabled, users with the required role will see this entry again and can access it.
features.disableDescription: Once disabled, the entry is hidden from the sidebar and direct access is also blocked.
features.reasonPlaceholderOptional: Enter a reason for the change (optional)

audit.title: {label} Audit Log
audit.limitHint: Shows at most the 100 most recent records
